description: GAF于1975年推出的旁轴相机。配备GAF Xytar 38 mm, f/2.8 (4 elements, 3 groups)。快门速度1/30-1/650s, plus B. (B setting only works at maximum aperture).。使用24x36mm (35mm)。感光度Manually set ISO 25-500.。1m to infinity.。

specs.镜头: GAF Xytar 38 mm, f/2.8 (4 elements, 3 groups)
specs.快门速度: 1/30-1/650s, plus B. (B setting only works at maximum aperture).
specs.闪光灯: "X" sync @ 1/25 Second; contacts on hot shoe and PC socket. Uses "flashmatic" system that utilizes the Guide Number (GN) of an attached electronic flash and the focus distance (10-40m).
specs.英文简介: The GAF Memo 35ET is a compact 35mm rangefinder dating from 1975.
